preconditions.description: The size of the first part of the bipartite graph is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The size of the second part of the bipartite graph is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and 100000, inclusive.
Each vertex in the first part of the graph has a number between 1 and a, inclusive.
Each vertex in the second part of the graph has a number between 1 and b, inclusive.
There are no multiple edges in the graph.

postconditions.description: The minimal number of colours is at least 1.
The minimal number of colours is at most 1000.
Each edge is assigned a colour between 1 and c, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: no two adjacent edges have the same colour
postconditions.description: No two edges that share a vertex have the same colour.
